For the three-marginal Coulomb cost in $\mathbb R^3$, the formalization constructs a smooth compactly supported probability density, with smooth compactly supported square root, for which no pair of measure-preserving Borel maps attains the Kantorovich minimum.” “Nevertheless, the Monge and Kantorovich infima are equal: preserving maps with finite costs approach the minimum.
